text:
Wavefronts are incident on a boundary.
What is needed for the wave to refract at the boundary?
A
a shiny surface at the boundary
B
a small gap in the boundary
C
different mediums either side of the boundary in which the frequency of the wave is different
D
different mediums either side of the boundary in which the speed of the wave is different

options.label: A
options.text: a shiny surface at the boundary

options.text: a small gap in the boundary
